AI: It's usually stress or dehydration. Drink some water.
Person: It's been going on for five days now.
AI: It could be a migraine. Try getting some rest.

_________________________
Scene 4 – Closing CTA
On-screen text:
YOUR SYMPTOMS DESERVE MORE THAN A SEARCH.
DON'T SELF-DIAGNOSE.
CONSULT A DOCTOR.

We've all searched our symptoms online at some point. But an online answer isn't the same as a medical diagnosis. 🩺
AI can help you access health information, but it cannot replace a doctor's examination and clinical judgment.
Don't ignore persistent symptoms or rely on self-diagnosis. Sudden vision changes or numbness can be signs of a medical emergency and require immediate medical attention.
💙 When it comes to your health, don't guess. Get the right medical advice

Your weight is changing without a clear reason? Your body might be telling you something. 💙
Unexplained weight loss or gain can sometimes indicate an underlying hormonal or metabolic condition. While not every change is a cause for concern, persistent or unexpected changes deserve attention.
At Nano Hospitals, we encourage you to listen to your body, recognise the signs, and seek medical advice when needed.
💙 Your health matters. Don't ignore the signs.

Can cancer be silent without any noticeable symptoms?  
 
   Timing
On-screen text
0:00–0:08
Cancer can sometimes be silent, without noticeable symptoms.
0:08–0:23
Recurrent, non-resolving fever can be an important clue.
0:23–0:32
Unexplained weight loss without dieting or lifestyle changes.
0:32 onwards
Unusual fatigue that makes everyday activities difficult.

Not every sign of cancer is obvious. Sometimes, the body gives subtle clues that are easy to overlook.
Recurring fever, unexplained weight loss and unusual fatigue may sometimes indicate an underlying health concern. In some cases, cancer may also be detected during routine screening, even without noticeable symptoms.
In this video, our doctor explains why it's important to pay attention to changes in your body and seek medical advice when symptoms persist.
Don't dismiss what your body is telling you. Early attention can make a difference.

Description for video:

Can your everyday deodorant or perfume increase your risk of cancer?
It's a question that often raises concern. While certain ingredients used in fragrances and personal care products have drawn attention, a direct link between their continued use and cancer has not been established by robust scientific evidence.
In this video, our doctor explains what we know, what remains uncertain, and why more research is needed.
Stay informed. Avoid assumptions. Make health decisions based on reliable medical guidance.
